arms.late: at = max(0, stall - 2): noise1-4 (fresh noise), wx0.5 and wx2 (guide weight x0.5, x2), leaf2 (every action dimension's next-ranked leaf among the frame's K = 8 prototypes, from the aligned frame on), release (frozen prior alone: no guide, no fold)
arms.replay: no change; the first all-fail instance of each task

metrics.branch: exact replay of the recorded episode (same server mode, program and fold; noise seed = the practice server's call count at each query) up to query `at`, then ONE change to the end of the episode
metrics.experiment: Exp. 2 of reports/RL from practice for composition.md: stall-point branching on the persistent failures, then recovery data

gates.G1: prefix gate: a branch counts only if its recorded 8-d states over steps < 5*at match the practice recording to max |diff| <= 1e-3; the fraction passing is reported; the primary reads use passing branches (and instances whose noise1 and knob branches both pass)
gates.G2: replay gate: each replay branch reproduces the recorded outcome; a mismatch is reported with its first diverging step

hypotheses.D1: rescue rate per arm on the 123 instances, Wilson 95%; any-late-arm rescue rate
hypotheses.D2: each knob (wx0.5, wx2, leaf2, release) vs late noise1 at the same state: paired by instance, exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs
hypotheses.D3: early vs late fresh noise (noise1, noise2 pooled; paired by instance and seed): exact sign test -- does the cause precede the stall?
hypotheses.rule: fresh-noise pass@4 from the late state >= 0.25: budget to selection (Exp. 3); a knob beats noise1 (D2 p < 0.05): per-phase repair (Exp. 6); every late arm <= 0.10: geometry or an earlier cause (Exp. 5)

metrics.instances: the 123 (task, init state) pairs of states 0-19 on which the first composition (m5_practice) and both fresh-noise retries (m5_redo _seed1, _seed2) failed; 17 tasks

recovery.R1: r18rec > r17bal (nft_bal) on init states 30-49 of the 9 concentrated tasks (42, 32, 1, 35, 40, 36, 52, 62, 41; 180 paired): exact sign test p < 0.05
recovery.R2: r18rec vs r17bal on every task with >= 1 rescue (secondary)
recovery.arm: r18rec: Experiment 1's r17bal data and loss unchanged (rank-16 LoRA, 8 negatives per batch of 32, 1000 steps, seed 0) + recovery positives: every 5th step of the post-branch segment (steps >= 5*at) of every RESCUED late or early branch (at most 300 per task, uniform subsample), added after r17bal's 1000-positive cap; + recovery negatives: the executed chunks of the last 2 queries up to the stall of each FAILED post-branch segment (its own pointer maximum, only if after the branch point)
recovery.caveat: the branches are extra rollouts (about 1,250 episodes); the budget-matched comparison is the round-3 success-only learner (loop L3, 630 more practice episodes)
recovery.condition: trained and scored only if >= 10 instances of the concentrated tasks are rescued by some branch; otherwise the diagnosis is the result

metrics.rescue: the branch episode succeeds (simulator success); secondary: the recomputed pointer passes the recorded stall frame
metrics.stall: first policy query at which the demo-alignment pointer (recomputed from the recorded states; Experiment 1's locator) reaches its final maximum
metrics.written_before: any r18 branch rollout (the prep job builds specs and programs only)
